pairs: Respondens autem Baldad Suhites, dixit:
Then Baldad the Suhite answered by saying:
Potestas et terror apud eum est,
Power
qui facit concordiam in sublimibus suis.
and terror are with him that makes a pact with those in high places.
Numquid est numerus militum ejus?
Is there any limit to the number of his soldiers
et super quem non surget lumen illius?
or to the number of those over whom his light rises?
Numquid justificari potest homo comparatus Deo?
Is it right for man to compare himself to God,
aut apparere mundus natus de muliere?
or to appear pure though he is born of woman?
Ecce luna etiam non splendet,
Behold, even the moon is not radiant,
et stellæ non sunt mundæ in conspectu ejus:
and the stars are not pure, in his sight.
quanto magis homo putredo,
Is man much more than rottenness
et filius hominis vermis?
and the son of man much more than worms?
